    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()

        return
    idx = 0
    n = int(data[idx]); idx += 1
    a = [0] * 3
    b = [0] * 3
    for i in range(3):
        a[i] = int(data[idx]); idx += 1

    max_wins = min(a[0], b[1]) + min(a[1], b[2]) + min(a[2], b[0])

    min_wins = 0
    if a[0] > b[0] + b[2]:
        min_wins += a[0] - (b[0] + b[2])
    if a[1] > b[0] + b[1]:
        min_wins += a[1] - (b[0] + b[1])
    if a[2] > b[1] + b[2]:
        min_wins += a[2] - (b[1] + b[2])

    print(f"{min_wins} {max_wins}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
